\section{Professional Summary}
More than 15 years of experience leading teams, optimising operations and driving sustained growth. At NOBACCO, rose from store manager to regional manager responsible for the region’s stores, a team of 30, eight franchisees and wholesale distribution across the Peloponnese, Western Greece and the Ionian Islands. Holds a Diploma in Computer Engineering and Informatics, combining technical expertise with leadership in business development. Now pursuing certifications in project management and modern technologies, and looking for roles that bring operations and technology together.
